name: Ransomware on a finance workstation
story: A user opens a weaponized invoice. PowerShell drops a LockBit payload that deletes shadow copies and beacons to its C2. The agent isolates the host, blocks the hash and the C2 it discovered, spots the same hash on a second host and asks for approval to isolate it, then pages on-call because ransomware is always critical.

incident.title: Ransomware activity detected on one endpoint
incident.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint detected ransomware behavior: suspicious process deleted volume shadow copies after being launched from an Office document.
